comparison.objective: Candidate installs a rack rail; record places three consumer devices on matching charging positions.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests rigid assembly, latching, extension, and tool use; record tests multi-object placement, magnetic alignment, flexible watch-strap handling, and visual charging confirmation.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks structural engagement and screws; record gives per-device credit for uninterrupted released charging with visible indicators and limits stand motion.
comparison.reason: No meaningful overlap beyond accurate released placement. Candidate does not yet quantify release clearance or fixture-motion tolerances.
